decisions.decision: Track frontend/convex/ in git, ignore only frontend/convex/_generated/
decisions.rationale: The blanket ignore meant schema, auth, http and auth.config would never be committed — half of plan 01-02's deliverable had no version history or rollback. User-selected option.

decisions.decision: Convex Auth JWT keypair generated with the official jose script, not openssl
decisions.rationale: Plan 01-02 originally prescribed openssl; Convex Auth expects the jose exportPKCS8 format and a mismatch fails silently at session issuance.

decisions.decision: Teal accent #0F5C56 on canvas #F7F4EE, locked in 01-UI-SPEC.md
decisions.rationale: Supersedes the looser wording in plan 01-01 Task 2; every visual decision defers to the UI-SPEC.
